notes: Signed configuration packages that MUST validate. canonical_bytes is the deterministic sorted key=value signing form - sorted flat text rather than JSON so Java and Swift reproduce it without depending on key ordering. The signature covers a domain prefix plus those bytes, so a config signature can never be replayed as a voucher signature. TESTONLY signing key; production keys live only in owner-controlled KMS/HSM (gate G-05).
